Most people spend months preparing for cosmetic surgery.

Researching surgeons. Comparing procedures. Planning time away from work or family.

Yet one of the most important parts of the journey is often overlooked: recovery.

Hi, I'm Nurse Zoë 🤍

I'm a Registered Nurse with over 10 years of experience in cosmetic surgery and recovery care.

As a perioperative nurse, I've worked in the operating room alongside some of Canada's leading plastic surgeons. Having worked in the OR and cared for patients during recovery, I've seen firsthand how much specialized post-operative care can influence the recovery experience.

I've worked with patients undergoing:

• Facelift and facial rejuvenation procedures
• Abdominoplasty (tummy tuck)
• Liposuction
• Breast augmentation
• Other cosmetic surgeries

Most patients are well prepared for surgery. Far fewer are prepared for what happens once they get home.

Pain. Swelling. Fatigue. Limited mobility. Medication schedules. Wound care.

Even simple things—getting comfortable in bed, preparing a meal, walking the dog, or remembering medications—can feel much harder than expected.

As a post-op concierge nurse, I support patients recovering at home, in hotels, private accommodations, or while traveling to Toronto for surgery.

My services include:

• Recovery monitoring
• Medication support
• Mobility assistance
• Wound care support
• Communication with your surgical team
• Early identification of concerns
• Emotional and psychological support
• And more...

My goal is to make your recovery a positive and nurtured experience, so you can focus on what matters most: healing.

I provide cosmetic surgery recovery support throughout Toronto and the GTA.

Planning cosmetic surgery?

Send me a DM to learn more about post-operative care, availability, and booking your recovery support.

Facelift · Facial Rejuvenation · Jawline | 52-year-old — I Didn’t Realize How Much My Profile Had Changed

At 52, the change is most visible when you look at the cheek and jawline together. Before the lift, the fullness of her cheek sat a little lower, the fold beside her nose was more pronounced, and the jawline softened near the chin.

In planning her Tri-Vector Lift™, Dr. Ye considered how the cheek curved toward the corner of the mouth and how the jawline continued into the neck. Afterward, the upper cheek looks more defined, the contour beside the mouth is smoother, and the line beneath the chin is easier to distinguish from the neck. Together, those details change the shape of her profile.

You might notice that your own profile looks different and find it hard to put your finger on where. That’s enough to start a conversation. You can reach us on WhatsApp for a free facial assessment with Dr. Ye. He’ll talk through what you’ve noticed and outline a plan based on your facial structure and what you’d like to address.

#TriVectorLift #Facelift #NaturalFacelift #JawlineDefinition #FacialRejuvenation

Facial Lift • Facial Rejuvenation • Jawline | 45 - When Facial Structure Loses Its Definition
+ A defined face isn‘t simply about having tight skin.
It’s also about where the underlying tissues sit.
At 45, her midface had gradually lost support. Lower cheek positioning, under-eye shadows, and early folds around the mouth made her facial contours appear less structured.
Her lower face also looked wider, with softer jawline definition and a less distinct transition beneath the chin.
Dr. Ye‘s patented Tri-Vector Lift™ focuses on repositioning descended tissues and improving structural support.
r Midface: Higher-looking cheek contours and improved facial balance.
* Under-eyes: A smoother transition between the lower eyelids and cheeks.
† Lower face: Less visible heaviness around the mouth and lower cheeks.
* Jawline: A more continuous, refined contour from the chin toward the jaw angle.
+ Face & neck: A cleaner transition beneath the jaw.
• The goal isn’t simply to make the face smaller.
It‘s to restore the relationship between facial support, tissue positioning, and natural contours.
Early bruising is still visible beneath her eyes, and her facial definition may continue to change as recovery progresses.
Explore a personalized facial assessment, tailored
lifting plan, and recovery guidance.
